input_fields.name: context_target
input_fields.description: One object/viewport context target and focus identity.

result_fields.name: context_menu_state
result_fields.description: Opened menu identity, target, location, and evidence that no menu command ran.

procedure: Focus context_target and place the cursor at right_click_position.
Issue one stationary right click without dragging.
Observe menu target/title and return context_menu_state.
Close/leave the menu for the caller; do not select a command in this atom.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous focus, right-button drag behavior, or a menu that cannot be tied to context_target.
Do not use right-button drag as a menu substitute without calibration.
Do not execute a menu command.
